title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Classes 11-12 and College (2676)
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 11-12, colleges, PhD and professional courses
Applicant must be a Madhya Pradesh domicile
For government/self-financed government institutions, the official record states no income limit for ST students
For eligible non-government non-professional courses, parents' annual income up to INR 6 lakh is stated
benefits: Eligible non-refundable fees and maintenance allowance according to eligibility
For eligible students in specified private institutions, payment of half of prescribed non-refundable mandatory fees is stated
documents_required: Not enumerated in the retrieved official record
application_process: Classes 11-12: apply through the Samagra portal
College-level: apply through the MPTAAS portal
important_sections_or_clauses: Payment is described as DBT/direct transfer to an Aadhaar-linked NPCI-active bank account for college students.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
